name: 55128 · Oakdale, MN
findings: ZIP 55128 (Oakdale) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55128 (Oakdale) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55128 (Oakdale) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
